code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pO₂, low pH), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, lymphopenia, and elevated monocytes and basophils. There is mild hypoalbuminemia, hypoproteinemia, and elevated ferritin, suggesting inflammation. INR is markedly elevated, indicating coagulopathy. These findings are consistent with severe respiratory failure, systemic inflammation, and possible sepsis or critical illness; urgent clinical assessment is recommended.
